historical_commentary.text: In-application help authoring techniques from this era have been largely superseded by modern approaches such as web-based help/documentation, tooltips backed by web areas, or externally hosted documentation, making the specific 4D 6.8/2003 help commands described here of mostly historical interest for current 4D development.
related_updates: Modern 4D applications more commonly use web-based help systems or externally hosted documentation rather than the native in-app help features emphasized in this note
